summary: The proposal has been revised. The next step is a 100-question pilot to check data quality, model performance and laptop costs.

milestones.title: Revise the proposal
milestones.note: Include the original GSM8K baseline, separate data groups and the helper-model plan.

milestones.title: Run the 100-question pilot
milestones.note: Check the rewrites, compare model sizes, choose batch size and train the original-solution baseline.

milestones.title: Complete five training conditions
milestones.note: Expand only if the pilot's memory, time and quality checks support it.

milestones.title: Freeze settings and evaluate
milestones.note: Use development data to choose settings before opening the official test set.

milestones.title: Submit the final report
milestones.note: Report the comparisons, costs, limitations and negative results.

decisions.title: Include untouched GSM8K training
decisions.reason: Rewriting must beat a model trained on the original worked solutions. This is a required baseline.

decisions.title: Use a capable helper for rewrites
decisions.reason: Claude or GPT can propose compact text. Check the math and count tokens with the small model's tokenizer. Qwen3-8B through Ollama remains a local fallback.

decisions.title: Let the pilot settle model and batch size
decisions.reason: Qwen3-0.6B is the starting candidate. Compare feasibility with 1.7B before fixing one model and one training setup for all conditions.

decisions.title: Keep the data groups separate
decisions.reason: The 100 pilot questions are inside the proposed 1,000 training questions. The 300 calibration and 200 development questions are different questions.
